name: Vivien's Stampede
oracle_text:
Each creature you control gains vigilance, trample, and melee until end of turn. (Whenever a creature with melee attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat.)
At the beginning of the next main phase this turn, draw a card for each player who was dealt combat damage this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of the next main phase this turn, draw a card for each player who was dealt combat damage this turn.

needs.what: a player spec (or value) naming every player who was dealt combat damage this turn by ANY source, so the delayed trigger's draw amount can be {"player_count": {"dealt_combat_damage_by": "any"}}; it needs a per-turn seat set folded off COMBAT_DAMAGE_TO_PLAYER that is never cleared per oid
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The player spec `dealt_combat_damage_by` (selectors._seats_dealt_combat_damage_by) accepts only "self", {"subtypes": [...]} (optionally with at_least) and {"any_of": [...]} -- no 'any creature' subject. TurnLedger.players_dealt_combat_damage_by is keyed by oid and an oid's entry is popped when it re-enters the battlefield, so a union over it would also be wrong. `damage_taken_this_turn` counts all damage, not only combat damage, and sums amounts rather than counting players; `player_count` with an objects comparison reads board counts, not the damage ledger. Listing every creature subtype under `subtypes` would miss creatures with no creature type and is an approximation. The delayed-trigger half (delayed_trigger on postcombat_main, duration once_this_turn) and the first sentence (grant_keyword vigilance/trample/melee) are expressible.
